observations.summary: City Hope Gilbert offers free clothing at 1120 S Gilbert Rd Suite 101, Gilbert 85296, Monday/Wednesday/Saturday 9–11:30 am; 480-900-5422. Walk in with government ID, once per center per calendar month; arrive fifteen minutes before closing and service can close at eighty guests. The Mesa site expressly provides food only; use Gilbert for a clothing proposal. No income or residence rule published on this page.
questions: Can guests without government ID receive clothing at Gilbert?

observations.summary: Paz de Cristo Clothing Closet at 424 W Broadway Rd, Mesa 85210 supports adults with casual and interview clothing, Mondays and Fridays 1–2 pm. Visit the campus; phone 480-464-2370. Children’s clothing is excluded. Wednesday shower service 9 am–1 pm includes clothes and hygiene items. Sizes and seasonal items depend on donated stock. The official Get Help page simultaneously offers appointment-only Deseret Industries vouchers and labels them temporarily unavailable; do not promise vouchers.
questions: Are Deseret Industries clothing vouchers currently available? The Get Help list says temporarily unavailable while the Clothe page says appointment only.
Does the Clothing Closet require ID, residency proof or other documents?
